notes.title: Hotfix - Laser Cannon Targeting & Emissive Feedback Fixes
notes.content: [p]This hotfix addresses two key issues reported by players:[/p][list][*][p]The ATM Laser Cannon's predictive aiming system was not functioning as intended. It now properly calculates and anticipates target movement for improved accuracy.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain weapons were missing emissive material activation when triggered, leading to a lack of visual feedback. This has been resolved, and emissive effects are now correctly displayed when those weapons are in use.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback. More updates soon![/p]

tags.bug: The ATM Laser Cannon's predictive aiming system was not functioning as intended. It now properly calculates and anticipates target movement for improved accuracy.

Certain weapons were missing emissive material activation when triggered, leading to a lack of visual feedback. This has been resolved, and emissive effects are now correctly displayed when those weapons are in use.

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
[p]We've just released a small hotfix to address an issue where lowering the Foliage Scalability setting would remove trees visually but leave their collisions active.
This not only caused players to bump into invisible objects, but also unintentionally improved visibility by removing natural cover, impacting gameplay balance.
Trees and foliage should now behave as intended across all graphic settings.[/p]
